answer: Hardware, not money, gates entry here. Each echo, one claimed agent, must register on the crystal, a ledger of enclave attestation keys, by binding one onyx, a tamper-sealed chip whose key is fused at manufacture and spent once bound. Clones sharing a host present the same key, collide on the crystal and are refused. A thousand echoes need a thousand physical chips from capped vendors whose per-buyer price doubles past five units. It breaks if enclave keys are extracted or straw buyers are cheap.
